name: Cashverse staking distributor public depositBNB swaps with no minimum output
summary: Unverified staking/reward distributor 0x2d70d62d held 225.995 BNB. Its public depositBNB() (0x42220f34) swaps the whole BNB balance for ADAcash through PancakeSwap with amountOutMin 0 once any stake exists. The attacker flash-borrowed 12,000 WBNB and pushed up the ADAcash price with 53 maximum-size buys. It then called depositBNB() and sold into the inflated pair, capturing the distributor's BNB.
notes: Owner 0x2198c955's enterStaking(10000e18) (0x41441d3b) wrote the first nonzero total stake (slot 7) into the distributor. It had been dormant since 2021 with 225.985 BNB. Before this write, depositBNB() returned without swapping; from this block on it swaps the full BNB balance with zero minimum. The runtime is unchanged since 2021 deployment.

Exact native BNB depletion of distributor 0x2d70d62deb1cb9918ff6be7bb5d173e8cd4ad854, recorded as the wrapped-BNB address and valued at the DefiLlama WBNB quote. The attacker's flash-loaned WBNB and buys are circular. The EOA's BNB balance rose by 150.36 BNB across the block; the rest went to pools and fees. The candidate figure of USD 107.9k is not this gross measure.

The distributor has no verified source; selector names come from the public signature database. The missing caller check and zero minimum are established from the trace (an attacker contract created in the same block was served; router call swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin 0). The age basis is established from debug_traceCall simulations and the slot-7 write, not from source text.
